title: The CI-yml check of the pipeline-trigger job reads each job by its top-level key, not blocks split at blank lines
goal: a check parses .gitlab-ci.yml into its top-level job keys (a line at column 0 ending in a colon) and asserts of each job except kb-job that it keeps when: manual or its own rules, and of kb-job that its rules name the trigger pipeline source and a KB_JOB variable, so a blank line inside a job or a new job is read right and a comment cannot satisfy it

run: import re; s=open('.gitlab-ci.yml').read(); jobs=re.findall(r'(?m)^([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+):\s*$', s); assert 'kb-job' in jobs
